record.label: Qubit counts and elementary-gate costs
record.statement: The authors report $O((m+k)n)$ qubits and $\mathrm{poly}(n,m,k)$ elementary gates for each unitary step. They report approximation error $2^{-\Omega(n)}$ for the diffusion steps compiled using quantum singular value transformation (QSVT).
record.boundary: The circuit specifies the workspace size and its cost theorem counts oracle rounds. A gate decomposition of the ideal unitaries is needed to bound the elementary-gate count and finite-precision error.
